title: Google Cloud Network Architecture & VPC Service Controls (Shared VPC, Private Access, Perimeters)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Cloud / identity / Gemini enablement).

Google Cloud Console / gcloud / Cloud Identity / Google Admin authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version- or preview-dependent capabilities (SCC tiers, BeyondCorp features, org-policy constraints, VPC-SC behaviors, Gemini Enterprise features) cited or flagged 'verify in your organization', never invented. IaC (Terraform / Cloud Foundation Toolkit) at the pattern level. Automation is Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries) — no hardcoded credentials, no committed service-account keys, no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Design a secure Google Cloud network with data-exfiltration perimeters
problem: A flat, default Google Cloud network with public API access is an exfiltration risk and a compliance gap. This solution designs the enterprise network: a Shared VPC topology, private connectivity (Private Google Access / Private Service Connect), hybrid connectivity patterns, firewall/egress policy, and VPC Service Controls perimeters that stop data from leaving trusted boundaries — so workloads reach Google APIs privately and data stays inside the perimeter.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the network reference: Shared VPC, private access, hybrid connectivity, firewall/egress model, and VPC Service Controls perimeter design.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Organization/landing zone, network admin roles, connectivity, gcloud toolchain).

Implementation Guide — build the Shared VPC + subnets, enable private access, apply firewall/egress policy, and design + enforce VPC Service Controls perimeters (dry-run first) — pilot-first, each artifact named.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (private access works, perimeter blocks exfiltration in dry-run then enforced) plus Best Practices for evolving perimeters safely.
short: Design a secure Google Cloud network — Shared VPC, private API access, firewall/egress policy, and VPC Service Controls perimeters that stop data exfiltration — so workloads connect privately and data stays inside trusted boundaries. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
